name: MonarchRenewalsPanel
title: RenewalsPanel
wrapsNative: MonarchSectionCard with a VStack of rows (Text, MonarchMoney, MonarchStatusBadge, MonarchIcon, Date.FormatStyle in the calendar's time zone), Picker with .pickerStyle(.segmented) or .menu inside ViewThatFits for the filters, Button with a plain style for rows, MonarchButton for the row action
summary: What renews or expires next: one row per renewal with its date and day count, amount, status, owner and next step, with filters, totals per currency and a row action.
whenToUse: On a billing, contracts or assets screen where people work through upcoming renewals: what is due, for how much, who owns it and what happens next.
whenNotToUse: For active recurring subscriptions with their monthly figure use MonarchSubscriptionsTable. For the cost of unused items use MonarchSavingsPanel.
api: init(_ items: [MonarchRenewalItem], title: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, filters: [MonarchRenewalFilter] = [], filter: Binding<String>? = nil, totals: [MonarchRenewalTotal] = [], unpricedCount: Int = 0, locale: Locale? = nil, now: Date? = nil, calendar: Calendar? = nil, urgentWithinDays: Int = 14, registry: MonarchStatusRegistry? = nil, isLoading: Bool = false, errorMessage: String? = nil, isRetrying: Bool = false, labels: MonarchRenewalsPanelLabels = MonarchRenewalsPanelLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onSelect: (@MainActor (MonarchRenewalItem) -> Void)? = nil, onAction: (@MainActor (MonarchRenewalItem) -> Void)? = nil, canAct: (@MainActor (MonarchRenewalItem) -> Bool)? = nil, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)

init(_ items: [MonarchRenewalItem], title: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, filters: [MonarchRenewalFilter] = [], filter: Binding<String>? = nil, totals: [MonarchRenewalTotal] = [], unpricedCount: Int = 0, locale: Locale? = nil, now: Date? = nil, calendar: Calendar? = nil, urgentWithinDays: Int = 14, registry: MonarchStatusRegistry? = nil, isLoading: Bool = false, errorMessage: String? = nil, isRetrying: Bool = false, labels: MonarchRenewalsPanelLabels = MonarchRenewalsPanelLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onSelect: (@MainActor (MonarchRenewalItem) -> Void)? = nil, onAction: (@MainActor (MonarchRenewalItem) -> Void)? = nil, canAct: (@MainActor (MonarchRenewalItem) -> Bool)? = nil) where Actions == EmptyView

struct MonarchRenewalItem { init(id: String, name: String, status: String, renewalDate: Date?, description: String? = nil, daysUntil: Int? = nil, noticeDeadline: Date? = nil, amount: Decimal? = nil, currencyCode: String? = nil, amountNote: String? = nil, autoRenews: Bool? = nil, probability: Int? = nil, owner: String? = nil, nextAction: String? = nil, nextActionDate: Date? = nil, isNextActionOverdue: Bool = false, outcome: String? = nil) }
struct MonarchRenewalTotal { init(currencyCode: String, amount: Decimal, count: Int, estimated: Decimal? = nil) }
struct MonarchRenewalFilter { init(value: String, label: String, count: Int? = nil) }

struct MonarchRenewalsPanelLabels { init(title:, list:, filters:, totals:, daysUntil:, noticeBy:, unknownDate:, unpriced:, autoRenews:, manualRenewal:, noOwner:, noNextAction:, overdue:, dueSoon:, probability:, totalIn:, estimated:, unpricedCount:, unpricedHint:, action:, actionFor:, emptyTitle:, emptyMessage:, errorTitle:, loading:) }

options.name: items
options.description: The renewals in view, already filtered and sorted by the app.

options.name: title
options.description: Replaces the built-in title Renewals.

options.name: description
options.description: A line under the title, such as when renewals appear and close.

options.name: filters
options.description: Filter options with optional counts. Shown as a segmented picker, or a menu when they do not fit. Needs filter.

options.name: filter
options.description: The selected filter value. The app filters items when it changes.

options.name: totals
options.description: The totals per currency, shown above the list. Never converted or added across currencies.

options.name: unpricedCount
options.description: How many renewals have no price, shown beside the totals with "Not included in the totals.".

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of amounts and dates. Default: the environment's.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for day counts. Default: the current time. Pass it for stable output.

options.name: calendar
options.description: The calendar and time zone of dates and day counts. Default: the environment's calendar in the environment's time zone.

options.name: urgentWithinDays
options.description: Open renewals this many days away or fewer, or past, show the warning icon.

options.name: registry
options.description: Statuses that add to or replace the built-in renewal statuses.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: Shows skeleton rows.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Shows the error state with this message.

options.name: isRetrying
options.description: Shows Try again busy.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Retries loading. Shows Try again in the error state.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Opens a renewal. Makes each row a button with a chevron.

options.name: onAction
options.description: The row action, such as opening an update form. Shows an Update button on each row.

options.name: canAct
options.description: Hides the row action for some renewals, such as closed ones. Default: shown for every renewal.

options.name: actions
options.description: Buttons or a menu at the trailing edge of the header, such as Check now.

states.name: list
states.description: One row per renewal, separated by dividers.

states.name: urgent
states.description: An open renewal due within urgentWithinDays, or past, has a warning icon in the strong warning colour before its date, read as Due soon.

states.name: overdue next step
states.description: The next step reads "Overdue: …" in the strong danger colour with a clock icon.

states.name: unpriced
states.description: No price in the muted text colour in place of the amount.

states.name: loading
states.description: The section card's skeleton rows, read as Loading renewals.

states.name: empty
states.description: A small MonarchEmptyState, No renewals coming up.

states.name: error
states.description: A small MonarchErrorState with the message and Try again when onRetry is given.

appearance: A MonarchSectionCard. Rows have the name in the strong body style with the amount at the trailing edge (stacked under it when it does not fit), the date in the label style, captions in the muted text colour, a small MonarchStatusBadge and a secondary Update button. Totals are captions over subheading MonarchMoney figures. All colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web shows a table with Item, Renewal, Amount, Owner and Status columns that drops columns on narrow screens; on iOS every renewal is a stacked row with the same facts, the phone pattern for a list with a detail screen (onSelect). The web's filters are a SegmentedControl; here a segmented Picker that falls back to a menu Picker when the options do not fit. The web's filterControls slot is left to the app (put extra controls above the panel), its href and renderLink become onSelect, its minorUnits flag is not offered (pass major units as Decimal, as MonarchMoney does) and its custom empty node is the labels' empty title and message. The web's headingLevel has no iOS equivalent. Android builds the same component; the iOS API uses a filter binding where Android passes selectedFilter with onFilterChange. Several closures are optional (onRetry, onSelect, onAction, canAct). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is onRetry.
accessibility: The title has the header trait (from MonarchSectionCard).

Each renewal is one element whose label is its name and whose value is built by a tested pure function: description, Due soon when urgent, date and day count, amount, status, probability, renewal note, owner and next step, outcome.
With onSelect the renewal is a button; the chevron is decorative.
The row action is a separate MonarchButton with a 44-point target, named "Update <name>".
Statuses have words and icons, urgency has an icon and the spoken Due soon, and overdue steps start with the word Overdue, so nothing depends on colour.
Each total is one element; the totals group is named Totals by currency.
edgeCases: A renewal without a date reads Unknown date and has no day count.
A notice deadline replaces the day count.
daysUntil from the server wins over the count worked out from now.
Days are counted between calendar days in the calendar's time zone, so a renewal later today is "today".
An unknown status key shows the neutral unknown look with a readable label made from the key.

examples.title: Filters, totals and actions
examples.template:
MonarchRenewalsPanel(
    [
        MonarchRenewalItem(
            id: {{items.0.id}},
            name: {{items.0.name}},
            status: {{items.0.status}},
            renewalDate: {{items.0.renewalDate|date}},
            description: {{items.0.description}},
            amount: {{items.0.amount}},
            currencyCode: {{items.0.currency}},
            amountNote: {{items.0.amountNote}},
            probability: {{items.0.probability}},
            owner: {{items.0.owner}},
            nextAction: {{items.0.nextAction}},
            nextActionDate: {{items.0.nextActionDate|date}},
            isNextActionOverdue: {{items.0.nextActionOverdue}}
        ),
        MonarchRenewalItem(
            id: {{items.1.id}},
            name: {{items.1.name}},
            status: {{items.1.status}},
            renewalDate: {{items.1.renewalDate|date}},
            description: {{items.1.description}},
            noticeDeadline: {{items.1.noticeDeadline|date}},
            autoRenews: {{items.1.autoRenew}}
        ),
    ],
    title: {{title}},
    description: {{description}},
    filters: [
        MonarchRenewalFilter(value: {{filters.0.value}}, label: {{filters.0.label}}),
        MonarchRenewalFilter(value: {{filters.1.value}}, label: {{filters.1.label}}),
    ],
    filter: $filter,
    totals: [
        MonarchRenewalTotal(currencyCode: {{totals.0.currency}}, amount: {{totals.0.amount}}, count: {{totals.0.count}}),
        MonarchRenewalTotal(currencyCode: {{totals.1.currency}}, amount: {{totals.1.amount}}, count: {{totals.1.count}}),
    ],
    unpricedCount: {{unpricedCount}},
    locale: Locale(identifier: {{locale}}),
    now: {{now|date}},
    calendar: calendar,
    onAction: { _ in }
) {
    MonarchButton({{actionLabel}}, variant: .secondary, size: .sm) {}
}
examples.code:
MonarchRenewalsPanel(
    [
        MonarchRenewalItem(
            id: "r1",
            name: "Example agreement",
            status: "open",
            renewalDate: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_794_096_000),
            description: "Contract · Example Co",
            amount: 1200,
            currencyCode: "USD",
            amountNote: "per year",
            probability: 60,
            owner: "Sam Lee",
            nextAction: "Send a quote",
            nextActionDate: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_793_664_000),
            isNextActionOverdue: true
        ),
        MonarchRenewalItem(
            id: "r2",
            name: "example.org",
            status: "in_progress",
            renewalDate: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_801_440_000),
            description: "Domain",
            noticeDeadline: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_798_761_600),
            autoRenews: true
        ),
    ],
    title: "Renewals",
    description: "Items appear when their notice window opens.",
    filters: [
        MonarchRenewalFilter(value: "open", label: "Open"),
        MonarchRenewalFilter(value: "all", label: "All"),
    ],
    filter: $filter,
    totals: [
        MonarchRenewalTotal(currencyCode: "USD", amount: 1200, count: 1),
        MonarchRenewalTotal(currencyCode: "EUR", amount: 300, count: 1),
    ],
    unpricedCount: 1,
    locale: Locale(identifier: "en-GB"),
    now: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_793_491_200),
    calendar: calendar,
    onAction: { _ in }
) {
    MonarchButton("Check now", variant: .secondary, size: .sm) {}
}
